title: Decisions by industry
subtitle: Every sector turns on a specific Microsoft architectural decision. Get it wrong and the implementation cannot fix it.

cards.imageAlt: Manufacturing plant floor, Business Central decision
cards.title: Manufacturing
cards.description: Business Central or Supply Chain Management is settled by your production data model, not your headcount. Discrete production belongs on Business Central Premium; process co-products require SCM.

cards.title: Healthcare PHI
cards.description: The BAA reaches Teams, Exchange, and SharePoint, but does not configure them: audit logs keep 180 days by default against a years-long lookback, requiring active Purview governance.

cards.imageAlt: Retail warehouse inventory management with barcode scanner
cards.title: Multi-Store Retail
cards.description: Most mid-market specialty retailers belong on Business Central rather than Dynamics 365 Commerce. Unified stock and POS visibility without paying for an enterprise pricing engine you won't use.

cards.imageAlt: Financial trading desk with dual monitors and market data
cards.title: Financial Services & Credit Unions
cards.description: NCUA Part 748 and GLBA compliance is a configuration state, not a licence. DLP for member NPI, 72-hour incident readiness, and audit retention proved to examiners.

cards.imageAlt: Aerospace engineer testing defense equipment with rugged laptop
cards.title: Federal & Defense Contractors
cards.description: Do you need GCC High or Commercial Microsoft 365 for CMMC Level 2? Scope from where CUI actually lands in your supply chain before committing to government cloud licensing.

cards.imageAlt: Medical device cleanroom quality testing and calibration
cards.title: Medical Devices
cards.description: Validating Business Central for FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ISO 13485 QMSR. Treating computer systems validation as a continuous update process rather than a one-time freeze.

cards.imageAlt: Electric utility control center grid monitoring dashboard
cards.title: Energy & Utilities
cards.description: Keep BES Cyber Systems off Microsoft 365 while governing BCSI and CEII under CIP-011 and CIP-004. Clear identity separation and field storm workflows for line crews.

cards.imageAlt: Logistics distribution warehouse manager checking tablet inventory
cards.title: Logistics & Supply Chain
cards.description: Can Business Central run a 3PL, freight, or distribution operation without a separate WMS? Bin-level tracking, EDI carrier feeds, and customer billing models compared.

cards.imageAlt: Construction engineers on jobsite reviewing BIM model on rugged tablet
cards.title: Construction & Engineering
cards.description: Business Central Projects versus construction-native ERPs. How job costing, WIP calculation, AIA pay applications, and field jobsite SharePoint governance fit together.
